newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Soquimich cut to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Soquimich cut to sell.

text.p: -- Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said on Monday it was downgrading its rating for Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile SA to sell from buy.
-- "SQM's dramatic earnings growth will come to an abrupt end in 1997," analyst Rene Kleyweg said in a report.
-- Earnings per American Depositary Receipt "are set to fall two percent in 1997, with 1998 earnings only recovering the lost ground.
-- "Consensus forecasts are 20 percent too high and with price/earnings multiples at over 20x in '97, we expect a 15-20 percent price correction."
